original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚阿南布拉州一住宅楼发生火灾
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚阿南布拉州首府阿沃卡Okenwa住宅区一栋平房发生火灾，财产和家用电器被毁。周日发生的这起事件未造成人员伤亡。阿南布拉州消防局表示，初步观察显示火灾可能由电路火花引发，但疑似原因尚未得到确认。

location.raw_text: Okenwa Housing Estate, behind Tourist Gardens Hotels, near the Anambra State Government House in Awka, Anambra State

key_facts.fact: 阿南布拉州阿沃卡Okenwa住宅区一栋平房发生火灾，财产和家用电器被毁
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Fire has gutted a bungalow at Okenwa Housing Estate, behind Tourist Gardens Hotels, near the Anambra State Government House in Awka, destroying property and household appliances.

key_facts.fact: 这起周日发生的事件未造成人员伤亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: No casualties were recorded in the incident, which occurred on Sunday.

key_facts.fact: 消防局称初步观察显示火灾可能由电路火花引发，但疑似原因尚未确认
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: preliminary observations suggested that the fire might have been triggered by a spark from an electrical circuit, although the suspected cause was yet to be confirmed

key_facts.fact: 消防员响应求救电话并扑灭大火，阻止火势蔓延至相邻建筑
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: firefighters responded to a distress call and successfully extinguished the blaze, preventing it from spreading to adjoining properties

uncertainties: 火灾疑似原因（电路火花）尚未得到确认
目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
